verdict.rationale: Twenty ships an official CLI (`npx create-twenty-app`, `npx twenty app:publish`) documented in the GitHub README for scaffolding apps and defining objects/fields/views as code, satisfying the 'official CLI' axis. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the CLI's reliability, and documentation of broader CLI capabilities beyond app scaffolding/publishing (e.g., data or workflow management from the CLI).
